_comment: Section 508 / WCAG accessibility baseline. Grandfathers existing violations, keyed by page -> [axe rule id]. Any (page, rule) NOT listed here counts as a NEW violation. Default posture is warn-only; set ICDEV_A11Y_ENFORCE=1 to fail on NEW critical violations. Regenerate against a live dashboard with: python tools/testing/a11y_sweep.py --update-baseline
